Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Clinical Pharmacologist (Infectious Diseases) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Clinical Pharmacologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Clinical Pharmacologist post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D.) from a recognized institution or university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Clinical Pharmacologist position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Clinical Pharmacologist role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Clinical Pharmacologist post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an MCQ Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for TMC Clinical Pharmacologist recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Tata Memorial Centre (TMC), Mumbai, Maharashtra, 400012.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a contractual job opportunity at Tata Memorial Centre.

faq.question: Q10. Does TMC offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such information.
